pr_title: [Button] Adds theme option to align button text and icon to either largest or current stylebox.
pr_body:
Alternative to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/92625

Adds new theme option (disabled for default theme and enabled for the editor theme) to control whether button elements are aligned to largest or current stylebox.

Fixes button issues cause by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/92009 without reintroducing https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/92009#issuecomment-2114744369

Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/92602
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/92466

issue_context.title: 4.3 beta 1 Button theme / content margin
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Not reproducible in Godot 4.3 dev6
- Reproducible in Godot 4.3 Beta 1

### System information

Godot v4.3.dev6 - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5244) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX (20 Threads)

### Issue description

After updating to Godot 4.3 beta 1 from 4.3 dev 6, I noticed that the content margin in a StyleBoxTexture is not applied.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/70795945/ec45967f-9101-41c4-b8d5-814a08d4dc9a

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/70795945/31c27d5e-14db-4baf-aa88-17095e31035b


### Steps to reproduce

- Create a button
- Create a new theme
- Assign the styles in StyleBoxTexture
- Modify the "content margin" when the button is pressed

I have prepared an example zip

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[button_theme.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/15517854/button_theme.zip)
